title: Flowstead flowsheet
description: The master copy of a Flowstead project (decision D5). Mirrors android/core app.flowstead.core.model.Flowsheet and engine Flowstead.Engine.Contracts.Flowsheet. All numbers SI.

atmosphericPressurePa.description: Reference for gauge pressures shown in this project

si.description: Value in the SI base unit

unit.description: Unit id the user typed it in (display only), e.g. barg

specs.description: User specifications (SI). Streams: temperature, pressure, vapourFraction, massEnthalpy, molarFlow, massFlow. Valve: outletPressure | pressureDrop. Heater/cooler: outletTemperature | duty, pressureDrop. Pump: outletPressure | pressureRise, efficiency. Compressor: outletPressure | pressureRise | pressureRatio, efficiency. Expander: outletPressure | pressureDrop | pressureRatio, efficiency. Heat exchanger: duty | hotOutletTemperature | coldOutletTemperature, hotPressureDrop, coldPressureDrop. Splitter: split1, split2. Adjust: target, tolerance, minimum, maximum.

composition.description: Overall mole fractions by compound (material streams); must sum to 1

refs.description: References to other objects. Adjust: manipulatedObject, manipulatedSpec (a spec key on that object), controlledObject, controlledProperty (a result key). Its specs: target, optional tolerance, minimum, maximum (SI).
